claim: A kSectorZMotionSprite sector (type 602) moves only the sprites standing in it that carry cstat 8192 (moved with the floor's on/off z) or 16384 (with the ceiling's); its own floor and ceiling stay where they are. It is how Blood raises bars or a portcullis while the ground under them stays put.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:1209 VSpriteBusy: only sprites with cstat&8192 / cstat&16384 get a new z; no floorz/ceilingz is written
E3M3 s254: type 602, off floor 141312, on floor 118784, rx 129 -- E3M3's portcullis (its sprite 198)
E3M3 s254's channel 129 is sent by two lever switches of tile 1070 (sprites 199 and 201, type 20), not by the valve wheel sprite 107 (which sends 124 to Z sector s94)
use: For bars, grilles or a gate that lifts out of a fixed floor, use type 602 with the bar sprites flagged 8192; use type 600 only when the floor itself should move.
